question.explanation: attr is a data descriptor (has __set__), so Descriptor.__get__ returns self.value * 2 = 10. instance_attr is set in __init__ to 10. special is intercepted by __getattribute__ returning 42. missing triggers __getattribute__ (which raises AttributeError for non-special names), causing __getattr__ to return f\"missing {name}\" → \"missing missing\".
